book.name: 1 CORINTO
book.title: 1 CORINTO Corinto janinhahbo qui Pablonen raanni joi

content: Dios Yoshiman noque hinanai shinan
Dios Yoshiman noque hinanresai sca tah hen mato yohicatsihqui, heen huetsabaan, man honannon hihxon.
Maton tah man noquen Papa honanyamapahonihqui. Jenquetsaha ra jaquin mato paranquin ta maton caibaan mato haxemacanishqui, yohuanyosma santobo man yocanon.

Jaa copi tah hen mato yohihi: Jesus Diosen queyopahinon hih ta tsoabi jatimahiqui, Dios Yoshiman shinanmahah. Man honannon hihxon tah hen mato yohihi. Dios Yoshiman shinanmayamahah ta Jesus ta noquen Hihbo qui hih tsoabi rihbi jatimahiqui.
Jaa huesti Dios Yoshin hihxon ta mesco shinan siribo noque hinanpaquehihqui.
Mesco tee rihbi non jai bi tah non jatihibi jaa Hihbo huestiya qui.
Mesco teebo non hahnon ta jaa huestichin noquen Papan noque mesco coshi hinanpaquehihqui, non jatihibijanon.
Non joni huetsa coshijanon ta jahuen shinan Dios Yoshiman noque hinanpaquehihqui.
Shinanyahpahax yohuannon ta caibo rihbi jaa shinan hinanihqui. Honan joi yohinon ta caibo rihbi jaa honan hinanihqui, jaanbi.
Shinancoinxon Papa Dios yocanon cahen caibo sca shinancoinxon yocati shinanbo rihbi hinanquin. Caibo rihbi sca joni huetsa rohajati hinanquin.

Caibo rihbi sca hinanquin, tsoan jascajani que ma bi Papan coshiyaxon hahti. Caibo rihbi sca hinanquin, Papan yohihi joi chaniti. Caibo rihbi sca honan hinanquin, jan merahi jenquetsahpa yoshin hin honanti. Caibo rihbi sca hinanquin, huetsa join yohuanti. Caibo rihbi sca hinanquin, nincacahbo yohuanxon mahnexonti honanti.
Jascapahbo mesco hahxontibo ta jaanbi noque shinanmahiqui, Dios Yoshin huestichin. Jaanbi shinanxon ta noque hinanpaquehihqui.
Jahuenahbo rahsi non hihqui

Noquen yora huestihax bi ta noquen mequenbo, noquen tahebo huestima qui. Jascarihbihi cahen noquen tahebo noquen mequenbo hichahax bi noquenah rahsi hihqui quescarihbihi noque jai, Cristonahbo rahsi. Noque cahen jahuen tahebo, jahuen mequenbo quesca, jahuenahbo.

Noque jatihibi hichahax bi huesti yora janon ta Dios Yoshin huestichin noque nashimahiqui, Noquen caibo, noquen nahuabo, patoroyahpabo, patorojomabo, noque nomimapaquequin hahcajaquin ta noque coshi hinanihqui, Dios Yoshiman.
Noquen yoran mehabo mesco hihqui bi cahen jascapahbo rahsima.
Hea ta mequenma qui. Jaa copi tah hen yoran mehama qui hih noquen tahe jai que bi cahen jascabi noquen yoran meha jaquehahna.
Hea ta beroma qui. Jaa copi tah hen yoran mehama qui hih noquen pabinqui jai que bi cahen jascabi noquen yoran meha jaquehahna.
¿Bero rahsi noquen yora hihxon cahran jahuatohon nincatihquin? ¿Pabinqui rahsi noquen yora hihxon cahran jahuatohon xehatihquin?
Shinanquin sirijaxon ta noquen yora Papan niahihninishqui, noquen berobo noquen pabinquibo noque hinanquin.
¿Poyan rahsihax cahran jahuen noquen yora jatihiquin?
Jaa copi ta noquen tahebo, noquen mequenbo hichahax bi jatihibi jaa yora huesti qui.

Hea tah hen miama qui. Jaa copi tah hen jahuama qui hah cahen noquen beron noquen mequen jatimahi. Hea ta matoma qui. Jaa copi tah hen hea jahua hihtimahi hah cahen noquen mapon noquen tahe jatimaribihi.
Jascayamabiresi. Noquen coshimabo cah non hashoan pishinai.
Non siriyamahi shinanai noquen yora mehabo tah non siri hihnon chopa sahuehi. Noquen jistimabo rihbi cah non chopan mahpohi.
Noquen jistibo ta mahpoti pishinyamahihqui. Papan ta noque niahihninishqui, noquen yoran meha coshiyamahibo siribo jaquin.
Jaa copi ta huesti yoran mehabo jaabo rahsibi rehtenantimahiqui. Jatihixonbi jaton hahbe yoran mehabaan shinanquin.
Jaa yoran meha huesti yomanahtaiya ta jatihibi hahbetan yomanahtiqui. Jaa yoran meha huetsa qui siripi yohuanaiya cahen jatihibi hahbetan jenimaribihi.
Criston yora sca tah man qui, mescohax bi jaa yoran meha rahsi.

Mesco tee ta Papan yohihihqui, caibo cahen jahuen raantibo janon. Jaatian sca cahen jahuen joi yohixonnicahbo janon. Caibo cahen honanmanicahbo janon. Caibo cahen tsoan jascajanima hahnicahbo. Caibo cahen rohajanicahbo. Caibo cahen yanapannicahbo. Caibo cahen teemanicahbo. Caibo cahen huetsa join yohuannicabo.
¿Jahuen raantibo rahsi non quin? ¿Jahuen joibo yohinica rahsi non quin? ¿Honanmanicahbo rahsi non quin? ¿Tsoan jascajanihma hahnicahbo rahsibo non quin?
¿Rohajanicahbo rahsi hihnon Papan noque hinanihquin? ¿Huetsa join yohuannicabo rahsi noque quin? ¿Joi mahnexonnicahbo rahsi noque quin?
Hihyamahi. Jascayamahi bi Hihbo hahxonnoxon jahuen hashoan siri hinantibo queennahue. Hashoan sirijahti rihbi tah hen mato rahma yohiscanoxihqui.
